decisions.decision: Keep /BM active for stored AP compositing under the effective Table 166 plus EC3 reading. Use an isolated exact-xref pixel regression with opaque colors so the unresolved ca/CA text does not enter the oracle.
decisions.evidence: Table 166 directly says /BM is used when painting the annotation onto the page and defaults to Normal. EC3 #23/#34 remove BM from the reader ignore list; #56 adds MK. §12.5.5 repeats BM in the composition sentence. Current code passes the annotation blend mode into the AP compositing state.
decisions.assertion: An opaque red AP Multiply-composited over an opaque blue page must be black by Table 134's componentwise multiply; Normal and absent /BM (Table 166 default) are red. A pixel outside the annotation remains blue. These literal expected values are independent of the renderer.
decisions.classification: Implementation regression for an effective behavior already present in the worktree, not a newly found failure. It does not settle the separate /ca and /CA opacity tension.
decisions.existing_test: crates/pdf-model/tests/stored_annotation_blend_spec_audit.rs already has the main target and Normal/default controls. Scratch draft adds outside-page control and explicit alpha assertions; parent should avoid promoting a duplicate if the existing test has already passed.
